```python
def _gen_print(self, node: ast.Call) -> str:
    if len(node.args) == 0:
        return 'printf("\\n")'
    if len(node.args) != 1:
        raise UnsupportedError("print() supports a single argument", node)
    arg = node.args[0]
    t = self._infer(arg)
    expr = self._gen_expr(arg)
    if isinstance(t, IntType):
        return f'printf("%ld\\n", {expr})'
    if isinstance(t, BoolType):
        return f'printf("%s\\n", ({expr}) ? "True" : "False")'
    if isinstance(t, FloatType):
        return f'printf("%g\\n", {expr})'
    if isinstance(t, StrType):
        return f'printf("%s\\n", {expr})'
    raise UnsupportedError(f"cannot print value of type '{t}'", node)
```
